```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
library(pheatmap)
library(RcisTarget)
library(readxl)

theme_set(theme_classic())

timepoints     <- c("T0", "T8", "T24", "T72")
padj_threshold <- 0.05
lfc_threshold  <- 1
set.seed(1)
```

```{r install, eval=FALSE}

if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("RcisTarget", ask = FALSE, update = FALSE)
install.packages(c("tidyverse", "glue", "pheatmap"))
```

# 1. Background (phototoxicity) correction

```{r correction-functions}
filter_background_genes <- function(main_df, bg_df,
                                    gene_col = "gene_id",
                                    lfc_col  = "log2FoldChange",
                                    padj_col = "padj") {

  sig_main <- main_df %>%
    filter(.data[[padj_col]] < padj_threshold,
           abs(.data[[lfc_col]]) > lfc_threshold)

  sig_bg <- bg_df %>%
    filter(.data[[padj_col]] < padj_threshold,
           abs(.data[[lfc_col]]) > lfc_threshold)


  overlap <- sig_main %>%
    transmute(gene = .data[[gene_col]], fc_main = .data[[lfc_col]]) %>%
    distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    inner_join(
      sig_bg %>%
        transmute(gene = .data[[gene_col]], fc_bg = .data[[lfc_col]]) %>%
        distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE),
      by = "gene"
    ) %>%
    mutate(same_direction = sign(fc_main) == sign(fc_bg))

  bg_genes           <- overlap$gene[overlap$same_direction]   
  opposite_direction <- overlap$gene[!overlap$same_direction]  

  list(
    cleaned            = sig_main %>% filter(!(.data[[gene_col]] %in% bg_genes)),
    removed_background = sig_main %>% filter(.data[[gene_col]] %in% bg_genes),
    opposite_direction = sig_main %>% filter(.data[[gene_col]] %in% opposite_direction),
    original_sig       = sig_main
  )
}

plot_volcano <- function(df, highlight_genes, highlight_label,
                         keep_label = "Significant",
                         gene_col = "gene_id",
                         lfc_col  = "light_response_fc",
                         padj_col = "padj",
                         title = "") {

  plot_df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      neglog10_padj = -log10(.data[[padj_col]]),
      category = case_when(
        .data[[gene_col]] %in% highlight_genes &
          .data[[padj_col]] < padj_threshold &
          abs(.data[[lfc_col]]) > lfc_threshold ~ highlight_label,
        .data[[padj_col]] < padj_threshold &
          abs(.data[[lfc_col]]) > lfc_threshold ~ keep_label,
        TRUE ~ "Not significant"
      )
    )

  cols <- c("grey85", "black", "red")
  names(cols) <- c("Not significant", keep_label, highlight_label)

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(.data[[lfc_col]], neglog10_padj, color = category)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 1.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_threshold, lfc_threshold), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_threshold), linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = title, x = "Light-response log2FC", y = "-log10 adjusted p-value")
}
```

```{r run-correction, message=FALSE}
results <- list()

for (tp in timepoints) {

  message(glue("Processing {tp}"))

  main_df <- read_tsv(glue("data/condition_Dark_vs_Light_at_{tp}.tsv"),
                      show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    
    mutate(light_response_fc = -log2FoldChange)

  bg_df <- read_tsv(glue("data/condition_WT_vs_Dark_at_{tp}.tsv"),
                    show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    
    mutate(light_response_fc = log2FoldChange)

  results[[tp]] <- filter_background_genes(
    main_df, bg_df,
    gene_col = "gene_id", lfc_col = "light_response_fc", padj_col = "padj"
  )

  removed <- results[[tp]]$removed_background$gene_id

  print(plot_volcano(main_df, removed, "Phototoxicity candidates",
                     title = glue("{tp} - before filtering")))

  print(plot_volcano(main_df %>% filter(!(gene_id %in% removed)),
                     removed, "Filtering failure", "Retained significant",
                     title = glue("{tp} - after filtering")))
}
```

```{r summary}
summary_df <- map_dfr(timepoints, function(tp) {
  tibble(
    Timepoint          = tp,
    Original_DEGs      = nrow(results[[tp]]$original_sig),
    Removed_BG         = nrow(results[[tp]]$removed_background),
    Opposite_Direction = nrow(results[[tp]]$opposite_direction),
    Final_DEGs         = nrow(results[[tp]]$cleaned)
  )
})
summary_df
```

# 2. Directionality QC (positive controls)

Known signaling / immediate-early genes should be **induced** by light. They should show **positive** `light_response_fc`. 

```{r directionality-qc, message=FALSE}
positive_controls <- c("FOS", "FOSB", "EGR1", "EGR2", "NR4A1", "ARC", "JUNB", "DUSP1")

qc_df <- map_dfr(timepoints, function(tp) {
  read_tsv(glue("data/condition_Dark_vs_Light_at_{tp}.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(gene_id %in% positive_controls) %>%
    transmute(gene_id, timepoint = tp,
              light_response_fc = -log2FoldChange, padj)
})

qc_df %>%
  mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = timepoints)) %>%
  arrange(gene_id, timepoint)
```

# 3. Gene lists for RcisTarget

```{r gene-lists, message=FALSE}
gene_lists <- list()
for (tp in timepoints) {
  df <- read_tsv(glue("output/cleaned_DEGs_{tp}.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
  gene_lists[[tp]] <- list(
    up   = df %>% filter(light_response_fc >  lfc_threshold) %>% pull(gene_id) %>% unique(),
    down = df %>% filter(light_response_fc < -lfc_threshold) %>% pull(gene_id) %>% unique()
  )
  message(glue("{tp}: {length(gene_lists[[tp]]$up)} up, {length(gene_lists[[tp]]$down)} down"))
}
```

# 4. RcisTarget

```{r rcistarget-load}


motif_rankings <- importRankings(
  "hg38_500bp_up_100bp_down_full_tx_v10_clust.genes_vs_motifs.rankings.feather"
)


motif_annot_v10 <- read_tsv(
  "motifs-v10nr_clust-nr.hgnc-m0.001-o0.0.tbl",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

```{r cistarget-run, message=FALSE}

aucMaxRank <- 0.05 * getNumColsInDB(motif_rankings)   


run_one <- function(genes, set_name, tp) {
  genes <- unique(genes)
  if (length(genes) < 2) {
    message(glue("  {tp} {set_name}: only {length(genes)} genes - skipped"))
    return(NULL)
  }

  auc_mat <- getAUC(calcAUC(
    setNames(list(genes), set_name), motif_rankings,
    aucMaxRank = aucMaxRank, nCores = 1, verbose = FALSE
  ))


  a_all <- if (set_name %in% rownames(auc_mat)) auc_mat[set_name, ] else auc_mat[, set_name]


  keep <- !str_detect(names(a_all), "^metacluster_")
  message(glue("  {tp} {set_name}: {sum(!keep)} metaclusters dropped before NES, ",
               "{sum(keep)} motifs normalised over"))
  a <- a_all[keep]

  nes <- (a - mean(a)) / sd(a)             

  tibble(geneSet = set_name,
         motif   = names(a),
         AUC     = round(a, 3),
         NES     = round(nes, 3)) %>%
    filter(NES >= 3) %>%                  
    arrange(desc(NES))
}

motif_results <- list()
for (tp in timepoints) {
  message(glue("Running RcisTarget for {tp}"))
  motif_results[[tp]] <- list(
    up   = run_one(gene_lists[[tp]]$up,   "Upregulated",   tp),
    down = run_one(gene_lists[[tp]]$down, "Downregulated", tp)
  )
}
```

```{r annotate, message=FALSE}
annotate_motifs <- function(ct, direction, tp) {
  if (is.null(ct) || nrow(ct) == 0) return(NULL)

  joined <- ct %>% left_join(motif_annot_v10, by = c("motif" = "#motif_id"))


  n_motifs <- n_distinct(ct$motif)
  n_hit    <- n_distinct(joined$motif[!is.na(joined$gene_name)])
  message(glue("  {tp} {direction}: {n_hit}/{n_motifs} motifs annotated ",
               "({round(100 * n_hit / n_motifs)}%)"))

  joined %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene_name)) %>%

    group_by(gene_name) %>%
    slice_max(NES, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%   # best motif per TF
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(timepoint = tp, direction = direction)
}

annotated <- list()
for (tp in timepoints) {
  annotated[[paste0(tp, "_UP")]]   <- annotate_motifs(motif_results[[tp]]$up,   "UP",   tp)
  annotated[[paste0(tp, "_DOWN")]] <- annotate_motifs(motif_results[[tp]]$down, "DOWN", tp)
}


tf_long <- bind_rows(annotated) %>%
  mutate(
    signed_NES = if_else(direction == "UP", NES, -NES),
    tf_label   = paste0(gene_name, "_", direction)
  )
```

```{r save-tf-tables}
dir.create("TF_results", showWarnings = FALSE)
for (tp in timepoints) {
  up   <- annotated[[paste0(tp, "_UP")]]
  down <- annotated[[paste0(tp, "_DOWN")]]
  if (!is.null(up))   write_tsv(up,   glue("TF_results/RcisTarget_UP_{tp}.tsv"))
  if (!is.null(down)) write_tsv(down, glue("TF_results/RcisTarget_DOWN_{tp}.tsv"))
}
write_csv(tf_long, "TF_results/tf_long_all.csv")
```

pka_targets_df <- read_delim("PKA_target_list.csv", delim = ";", show_col_types = FALSE)

pka_targets_humans <- pka_targets_df %>%

# 5b. Cilia-APEX localization

```{r apex-load, message=FALSE}


apex_file <- "41467_2026_73505_MOESM3_ESM.xlsx"   

apex <- read_excel(apex_file, sheet = "Final", skip = 2)
names(apex) <- trimws(names(apex))

apex <- apex %>%
  filter(!is.na(Genes)) %>%                        
  mutate(
    det_cilia = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`Detected in Cilia`)),
    det_cyto  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`Detected in Cytoplasm`)),
    ratio     = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`Cilia/Cytoplasm`)),
    localization = case_when(
      det_cilia > 0 & det_cyto > 0                 ~ "Cilia + Cytoplasm",
      det_cilia > 0 & (is.na(det_cyto) | det_cyto == 0) ~ "Cilia",
      TRUE                                          ~ "Cytoplasm/Not found"
    )
  )


loc_map   <- setNames(apex$localization, apex$Genes)
ratio_map <- setNames(apex$ratio,        apex$Genes)


classify_localization <- function(genes) {
  out <- unname(loc_map[genes])
  out[is.na(out)] <- "Cytoplasm/Not found"
  factor(out, levels = c("Cilia", "Cilia + Cytoplasm", "Cytoplasm/Not found"))
}

localization_colors <- c(
  "Cilia"               = "#08519C",   # darkest = cilia-restricted
  "Cilia + Cytoplasm"   = "#6BAED6",
  "Cytoplasm/Not found" = "#EEEEEE"
)
```

# 6. Matrices and annotations 

```{r matrices}

build_matrix <- function(long_df, value_col) {
  d <- long_df %>%
    select(tf_label, timepoint, all_of(value_col)) %>%
    distinct()
  names(d)[names(d) == value_col] <- "value"
  m <- d %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value) %>%
    column_to_rownames("tf_label") %>%
    as.matrix()
  for (tp in setdiff(timepoints, colnames(m)))
    m <- cbind(m, `colnames<-`(matrix(NA_real_, nrow(m), 1), tp))
  m[, timepoints, drop = FALSE]
}

nes_mat <- build_matrix(tf_long, "signed_NES")
```

```{r sig-matrix}

sig_mat <- tf_long %>%
  mutate(sig_label = case_when(abs(signed_NES) > 4 ~ "**",
                               abs(signed_NES) > 3 ~ "*",
                               TRUE ~ "")) %>%
  select(tf_label, timepoint, value = sig_label) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value) %>%
  column_to_rownames("tf_label") %>%
  as.matrix()
for (tp in setdiff(timepoints, colnames(sig_mat)))
  sig_mat <- cbind(sig_mat, `colnames<-`(matrix("", nrow(sig_mat), 1), tp))
sig_mat <- sig_mat[, timepoints, drop = FALSE]
sig_mat[is.na(sig_mat)] <- ""
```

```{r annotation-objects}
col_anno <- data.frame(
  Timepoint = factor(timepoints, levels = timepoints),
  row.names = timepoints
)
col_anno_colors <- list(
  Timepoint = c("T0" = "#402C60", "T8" = "#715A82",
                "T24" = "#A27EAB", "T72" = "#C3A8C7")
)
row_anno_colors <- list(
  direction    = c(UP = "#B2182B", DOWN = "#2166AC"),
  PKA_target   = c(Yes = "#0B6623", No = "#D9D9D9"),
  Localization = localization_colors
)
```

# 7. Heatmaps

```{r heatmap-helper}

plot_tf_heatmap <- function(tf_labels, title, file = NULL, cluster = TRUE) {

  tf_labels <- intersect(tf_labels, rownames(nes_mat))
  if (length(tf_labels) == 0) {
    message("Nothing to plot for: ", title); return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  m   <- nes_mat[tf_labels, , drop = FALSE]
  sig <- sig_mat[tf_labels, , drop = FALSE]

  row_anno <- tibble(tf_label = tf_labels) %>%
    mutate(
      gene_name    = str_remove(tf_label, "_(UP|DOWN)$"),
      direction    = str_extract(tf_label, "(UP|DOWN)$"),
      PKA_target   = if_else(gene_name %in% pka_targets_humans, "Yes", "No"),
      Localization = as.character(classify_localization(gene_name))
    ) %>%
    column_to_rownames("tf_label") %>%
    select(direction, PKA_target, Localization)


  row_clust <- FALSE
  if (cluster && length(tf_labels) > 1) {
    m0 <- m; m0[is.na(m0)] <- 0
    row_clust <- hclust(dist(m0))
  }

  lim <- max(abs(m), na.rm = TRUE)

  ph <- pheatmap(
    m,
    scale           = "none",
    cluster_cols    = FALSE,
    cluster_rows    = row_clust,
    labels_row      = str_remove(tf_labels, "_(UP|DOWN)$"),
    display_numbers = sig,
    number_color    = "#202020",
    fontsize_number = 9,
    color           = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(100),
    breaks          = seq(-lim, lim, length.out = 101),
    na_col          = "grey90",
    cellwidth       = 25,
    cellheight      = 10,
    fontsize_row    = 9,
    angle_col       = 45,
    border_color    = NA,
    annotation_row  = row_anno,
    annotation_col  = col_anno,
    annotation_colors = c(row_anno_colors, col_anno_colors),
    main            = title,
    silent          = TRUE
  )

  grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(ph$gtable)   
  if (!is.null(file)) {
    pdf(file, width = 12, height = max(6, length(tf_labels) * 0.3))
    grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(ph$gtable)
    dev.off()
  }
  invisible(ph)
}
```

```{r select-tfs}
top_n <- 30

top_up <- tf_long %>% filter(direction == "UP") %>%
  group_by(tf_label) %>% summarise(s = max(signed_NES), .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_max(s, n = top_n) %>% pull(tf_label)

top_down <- tf_long %>% filter(direction == "DOWN") %>%
  group_by(tf_label) %>% summarise(s = max(abs(signed_NES)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_max(s, n = top_n) %>% pull(tf_label)
```

```{r carnival-export}
top_labels <- c(top_up, top_down)


nes_export <- tf_long %>%
  filter(tf_label %in% top_labels) %>%

  group_by(gene_name, timepoint) %>%
  slice_max(abs(signed_NES), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()


clashes <- tf_long %>%
  filter(tf_label %in% top_labels) %>%
  distinct(gene_name, timepoint, direction) %>%
  count(gene_name, timepoint) %>%
  filter(n > 1)
if (nrow(clashes) > 0)
  message(glue("{nrow(clashes)} gene x timepoint up/down clashes resolved by |NES|"))


nes_wide <- nes_export %>%
  select(gene_name, timepoint, signed_NES) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = signed_NES) %>%
  arrange(gene_name)

write_csv(nes_wide, "TF_results/top30_TF_NES_for_CARNIVAL.csv")
message(glue("Exported NES for {nrow(nes_wide)} TFs across ",
             "{ncol(nes_wide) - 1} timepoints"))
```


```{r heatmap-carnival-input}

mat <- nes_wide %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_name") %>%
  as.matrix()
mat <- mat[, timepoints, drop = FALSE]          


row_clust <- if (nrow(mat) > 1) {
  m0 <- mat; m0[is.na(m0)] <- 0
  hclust(dist(m0))
} else FALSE

lim <- max(abs(mat), na.rm = TRUE)             

pheatmap(
  mat,
  scale             = "none",
  cluster_cols      = FALSE,
  cluster_rows      = row_clust,
  color             = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(100),
  breaks            = seq(-lim, lim, length.out = 101),
  na_col            = "grey90",
  cellwidth         = 25,
  cellheight        = 10,
  fontsize_row      = 8,
  angle_col         = 45,
  border_color      = NA,
  annotation_col    = col_anno,
  annotation_colors = col_anno_colors,
  main              = "Top TF motif NES (CARNIVAL input)",
  filename          = "TF_results/top30_TF_NES_heatmap.pdf",
  width             = 6,
  height            = max(6, nrow(mat) * 0.18)
)
```

```{r pka-cilia-ratio, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}

pka_genes  <- unique(str_remove(pka_labels, "_(UP|DOWN)$"))
both_genes <- pka_genes[classify_localization(pka_genes) == "Cilia + Cytoplasm"]

ratio_df <- tibble(gene = both_genes, ratio = unname(ratio_map[both_genes])) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ratio)) %>%
  arrange(desc(ratio))

if (nrow(ratio_df) == 0) {
  message("No PKA-target TFs detected in both compartments.")
} else {
  print(
    ggplot(ratio_df, aes(reorder(gene, ratio), ratio)) +
      geom_col(fill = "#6BAED6") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_y_log10() +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Cilia / Cytoplasm ratio (log scale)",
           title = "Cilia/cyto enrichment - PKA-target TFs in both compartments")
  )
  ratio_df
}
```

# 8. Per-direction NES barplots (optional)

```{r barplots}
for (tp in timepoints) {
  for (dir in c("UP", "DOWN")) {
    d <- annotated[[paste0(tp, "_", dir)]]
    if (is.null(d) || nrow(d) == 0) next
    top <- d %>% arrange(desc(NES)) %>% slice_head(n = 20)
    print(
      ggplot(top, aes(reorder(gene_name, NES), NES, fill = NES)) +
        geom_col() +
        scale_fill_gradient(low = "#BFD7EA", high = "#0B3954") +
        coord_flip() +
        labs(title = glue("{tp} - TF motifs ({dir} genes)"), x = "TF", y = "NES")
    )
  }
}
```
